MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "The M6 screws and M8 kit fit my recent purchases of metric stainless fasteners. They add useful sizes for assemblies, and the M8 kit includes matching nuts and washers.",
    "The locking casters fit my workshop building interests, while the clamp meter connects with my interest in inspection and measurement tools. Both appeal to me, though choosing them depends on mounting compatibility or an electrical troubleshooting need."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "Deck joist tape does not serve the same purpose as my adhesive strips and mounting tape. My purchases supported fastening and repairs, which does not imply I am waterproofing a deck.",
    "The pipe fitting, replacement handwheel, and long carriage bolts require particular connections, machines, or projects. I have no current need that makes those exact parts useful.",
    "The large exterior screw pack duplicates a supply I already have and assumes a decking project that my recent purchases do not establish."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "My purchases of screws and adhesives seem to have been taken as a broader interest in deck construction, even though the intended uses differ.",
    "My interest in workshop supplies seems to have been stretched to include specialized replacement parts without a matching repair need."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "My repeated purchases of fastener assortments suggest that useful size coverage and matching hardware matter to me. The M6 and M8 options connect more directly to that pattern.",
    "Thread standard, dimensions, and mounting fit affect whether I can use a part. A broadly relevant tool or component still needs to fit my equipment and current work.",
    "Buying supplies frequently does not mean I need bulk quantities of something I already own; additions that expand what I can build are more appealing."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The recommendations recognize my workshop and fastener interests but too often assume a specific construction or repair project from a superficial similarity."
}
